notes: The three-level chain ark / covenant / Jehovah carries no article morpheme, so each construct takes the supplied the standing before its own word under rule 29's allowance for a second the in a multi-level chain.
ha-yom is fused to the adverbial to day under rule 30, headed on the noun carrying the lexeme; 1SA.4.16 reads the same phrase the same way.
lammah heads on the interrogative, which carries the content the preposition lacks (rule 23).
